meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Cross-checked the shared backend guidance with unchanged Support/Enterprise registries and private conversation persistence. New anonymous shopping capabilities add no agent identity, owner query, raw tool evidence or developer instruction exposure.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Cross-reviewed current-price cart paise precision, captured-INR predicate, shared idempotent VerifiedOrderService, actual-discount GST and frozen tax evidence. Order/checkout docs distinguish captured payment from saved order and preserve later browser-cart edits on retry.

content.review_note: Reviewed the Docs skill provenance guidance against the unchanged BlogService and authored-content guide boundary. Static map references are discovery evidence only; publication visibility, Markdown storage, rendering and private-help exclusion remain the existing source contracts.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the WebMCP verification guide against local/live native fixtures, the shared CDP adapter and official Chromium schemas. Documented toolId/name selection, exact registry and correlated contact completion; architecture, permissions and production application code are unchanged.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the integrations/layout dependency changes: new webhook secret controls and commerce assets do not change Google tag values, consent, account linking or reporting. The existing settings guide retains the configuration-versus-provider-verification distinction.

http-errors.review_note: Cross-checked the explicit Stripe namespace fallback against the existing canonical client and checkout call sites. RequestFailureService registration, CLI failure handling and exact MCP/webhook session bypass remain unchanged. The regression captures the real bootstrap before any fixture preload.

interface.review_note: Cross-reviewed native Support product actions, inline form, quote/status and history isolation, Shop-off recovery, shared MCP App and merchant continuation against Design and frontend skill. Public A2UI stays declarative; native/external fallback limits are explicit.

mail.review_note: Reviewed verified-order extraction and its winning-insert-only existing queue boundary. Payment/order persistence does not prove SMTP acceptance or inbox delivery, and no mail provider, recipient or replay behavior is broadened.

mcp-clients.review_note: Cross-checked public HTTP commerce scopes against the unchanged owner STDIO grant path; shop and integrations docs explicitly separate six remote actions from local reporting credentials and describe the new webhook fields.

media.review_note: Cross-checked architecture and official product image paths against unchanged media ownership/storage rules. Chat cards use bounded published same-origin raster projections; no image binary, upload location or media permissions changed.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the unchanged private guide manifest and metadata-only KnowledgeGraph indexing with the operator-help guide. The generator now labels declared relationships and preserves JSON response metadata; it does not change guide permissions, bodies, routes or user controls. Reviewed the updated Docs skill limits.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the unchanged stateless MCP/discovery controllers and registered handlers with the public transport guide. Corrected map-only inheritance and related-view claims; source references do not imply browser-session inheritance, successful gateway autoload or a rendered JSON response. No protocol, capability or checkout behavior changed.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed both merged checkout and WebMCP guide changes against their sources. The canonical Stripe bootstrap mapping and before-fixture regression are preserved. New live CDP checks discover the unchanged six commerce names but invoke only get_public_contact with empty input; no provider operation, cart/payment mutation or external-host rendering acceptance is implied.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed the sales-channel CLI references and catalogue guidance. This change only fixes generic PHP lint argument forwarding and failure propagation; feed, channel and catalogue operations are unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Compared the bounded map tokenizer, source line evidence, import/interpolation decoys, JSON response metadata and declared relationship labels with the development workflow and Docs skill. Also read the merged CDP helper and both CI hooks: the exact page registry, one correlated public contact read, explicit protocol failures and separate polyfill/native/external-host limits remain intact. Preserved the early Stripe bootstrap regression; no application dispatch or checkout behavior changed.
